SDCard Block Size

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x28
Size:
0x4
Source:
adc_acquisition_reg_definition.rdl

Description

Bytes per SD block, written by the HW copy engine into SDHCI BLOCK_SIZE at the start of every CMD25 session. Must be 512 for SDHC/SDXC cards, which fix the write block length. Software must keep this consistent with the session geometry: SDCARD_BLOCK_SIZE * SDCARD_BLOCK_COUNT must equal the session's byte count -- one frame (F0_END_ADDR - F0_START_ADDR + 4) in SDCARD_CONTINUOUS mode, both frames added together in SDCARD_PULSE mode.
